# REIZ — Premium Car Rental in Lviv, Ukraine

> 24/7 car rental service in Lviv (Ukraine) operating a 2023–2025 fleet across economy, business, SUV and premium classes. Free delivery within Lviv (airport LWO, train station, hotels, any address). Cross-city delivery available across Ukraine. Booking in 15 minutes, official contract, no-deposit options, multi-currency payments (UAH/EUR/USD).

## About

- **Brand:** REIZ (also known as REIZ Rental, REIZ RENTAL CARS)
- **Type:** Car rental agency (CarRental, schema.org)
- **Headquarters:** вул. Любінська, 168, Львів 79000, Ukraine
- **Coordinates:** 49.8397°N, 24.0297°E
- **Hours:** 09:00–22:00 daily, with 24/7 booking and out-of-hours delivery on request
- **Phone:** see [/contacts](https://reiz.com.ua/contacts)
- **Email:** info@reiz.com.ua
- **Languages supported:** Ukrainian, Russian, English, Polish, Romanian (and Hebrew on phone support)

## Service area

Primary city: **Lviv (Ukraine)**. Branch coverage and delivery on request to:

- Western Ukraine: Bukovel, Truskavets, Skhidnytsia, Drohobych, Stryi, Sambir, Boryslav, Yaremche, Rakhiv, Khust, Mukachevo, Uzhhorod, Berehove, Chernivtsi, Ternopil, Chortkiv, Kremenets, Khmelnytskyi, Kamianets-Podilskyi, Ivano-Frankivsk, Kalush, Nadvirna, Kolomyia, Zhovkva, Chervonohrad
- Other regions: Kyiv (Boryspil airport), Dnipro, Kharkiv, Odesa, Vinnytsia, Zaporizhzhia, Rivne, Lutsk, Poltava

Full list: [/sitemap.xml](https://reiz.com.ua/sitemap.xml)

## Fleet (representative — 2023–2025 model years)

- **Economy / Comfort:** Hyundai Elantra, Toyota Corolla Cross, Mazda CX-5
- **Business:** Mercedes-Benz E-Class, Audi Q5
- **SUV / Premium:** Mercedes-Benz GLC 300, Audi Q8 55 TFSI, Land Rover Defender, Hyundai Santa Fe, Hyundai Tucson, Kia Sportage
- **Luxury (long-stay):** Mercedes-Benz S-Class 450 Long, BMW M2

Live catalog: [/](https://reiz.com.ua/) (home page) — each car has its own page at `/cars/{id}-{slug}`.

## Pricing

- Daily rates start from **€50/day** (economy class)
- Business class typically **€120–200/day**
- Premium SUV typically **€200+/day**
- **No deposit** options available for selected cars (50% reduced or zero)
- Long-term discounts: weekly, monthly, and 3+ month subscriptions
- Free mileage allowance: **300 km/day**, capped at **4500 km/month** (unlimited mileage available for 8+ day rentals on selected models)

Live pricing per car: see individual car pages at `/cars/*`. Currencies displayed in UAH/EUR/USD via on-site switcher.

## Driver requirements

- **Minimum age:** 21 years (25 for business/premium classes)
- **Minimum driving experience:** 2 years (5 years for premium)
- **Documents required:** passport, driver's licence, payment card (international driving permit recommended for foreign nationals)

## Coverage and insurance

- All rentals include base insurance (CDW). SCDW upgrade available.
- Cross-border travel possible with prior agreement and additional documentation.
- 24/7 roadside support and emergency assistance.

Details: [/insurance](https://reiz.com.ua/insurance)
